test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

He was that angry that he slammed the book on the table.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"that angry."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"that angry."**
 
• The sentence uses the phrase** 'that angry'**, which is redundant as** 'angry' **already expresses the intensity of emotion.
 
• The correct way to write the sentence would be: *"He was so **angry**__ that he slammed the book on the table."*
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
